description:
Standalone, self-contained `java -jar` command-line entry point (FlowCli) over
        selenide-flows' FlowDiscovery/FlowRuntime. Split out from selenide-flows itself so that
        module's own Selenide dependency can be `provided` (deferring to a consumer's own
        installation) without breaking this module's need to bundle a real Selenide into its
        shaded jar - see selenide-flows/README.md for why.
